items.problem: SKILL.md instructs the migration agent to compile with `winapp build`, a subcommand that does not exist in the winapp CLI. Following it produces a hard failure and a wasted recovery turn.
items.evidence: session-log.txt L3742-3773: `winapp build` -> "'build' was not matched ... Unrecognized command or argument 'build'", WINAPP_BUILD_EXIT=1; agent recovered with `dotnet build` at L3778. winapp help (L3744-3770) has no `build` verb. Skill grep: SKILL.md L126/L140/L173, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md L726, Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 L13-14.
items.root_cause: The skill hard-codes a nonexistent winapp verb for compilation. winapp is a packaging/identity/run/UI CLI (SKILL.md L14); the plugin's real build command is native `dotnet build`, already used successfully elsewhere in the same trial — so the `winapp build` text is internally inconsistent and always fails.
items.change: Replaced every `winapp build` compile instruction with `dotnet build -c Debug; "BUILD_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE"` in SKILL.md (Step 3 code block, Build-command-discipline bullet, Step 4 final-build line); added an explicit note that winapp has no `build` verb. Reworded MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md analyzer paragraph to attribute analyzer injection to the WindowsAppSDK NuGet reference at `dotnet build` time. Fixed the Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 header comment to reference `dotnet build` (comment only).
items.expected_effect: The migration agent compiles with a command that actually exists, eliminating the guaranteed `winapp build` failure and the recovery turn it costs.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run, the build/close-out step issues `dotnet build` and there is no `winapp build` invocation (hence no "'build' was not matched" error, no WINAPP_BUILD_EXIT=1) in the session log.
